def: to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish apotion to
kjv: cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See H7937 (שָׁכַר), H8354 (שָׁתָה).

words.word: oh that one would give me drink
